node.statement: Proposition 5.1 (Moment operator formalism): Let psi_sym be a mixed state on Sym^n(C^d). If |v> is the Hayashi measurement outcome, then E[sigma_hat_v^{tensor k}] = tr_{1..n}(M_mom^{(k)} (psi_sym tensor I^{tensor k})), where M_mom^{(k)} = d[n](d+n)^{up k} integral |u><u|^{n+k} du [with debiasing factors]. This follows from the definition of Hayashi POVM and the GPS debiasing sigma_hat_v = ((d+n)/n)|v><v| - (1/n)I.
